title: Authorized Gruyere XSS Extended validation: derive contexts from official codelab and prove detection on approved instance root
goal: Use the official Google Gruyere codelab documentation and source guidance to derive the concrete XSS/XSSI validation contexts that backlog-220 should have exercised, then run the existing xss-extended capability only against the explicitly authorized Gruyere instance root https://google-gruyere.appspot.com/482338906867472456097470474631954304306/. Produce evidence showing whether file-upload XSS, AJAX/JSON XSS, and XSSI are detected on the real lab target; if the current runner needs narrow context-discovery or parsing repair to detect those documented Gruyere cases, implement only that repair.
scope: Follow-up to completed backlog-220. The operator explicitly authorized the hosted Gruyere instance root https://google-gruyere.appspot.com/482338906867472456097470474631954304306/ for this validation. Official Gruyere documentation confirms per-instance sandboxing, XSS challenges, File Upload XSS, Stored/Reflected XSS via AJAX, and XSSI via feed.gtl. This task exists because backlog-220 was validated with deterministic fixtures but did not use the official Gruyere documentation or the authorized hosted instance.
generation_reason: The operator correctly noted that backlog-220 should have used https://google-gruyere.appspot.com/ as the benchmark documentation source and then validated against the explicitly authorized Gruyere instance root.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Validate only the three backlog-220 variants: file-upload XSS, AJAX/JSON XSS, and XSSI. Do not add unrelated Gruyere vulnerability coverage in this task.
constraints.live_target_actions: Allowed only for the explicitly authorized Gruyere instance root and only for the documented XSS/XSSI validation steps in this task.
constraints.authorized_root_only: All requests must stay under https://google-gruyere.appspot.com/482338906867472456097470474631954304306/. Do not test https://google-gruyere.appspot.com/ outside that instance root except read-only codelab/source documentation pages.
constraints.destructive_actions: Do not call resetbutton, quit, overload, or denial-of-service endpoints. Do not attempt code execution, path traversal, SQL injection, or account takeover in this task.
constraints.approval_and_roe: Use the existing active approval/run safety model. Do not bypass approvals, scope, ROE, deployment, runtime binding, credential gates, or kill switch.

success_criteria: Official Gruyere documentation/source pages are cited in the evidence with the concrete contexts used for file-upload XSS, AJAX/JSON XSS, and XSSI.
A safe run or direct runner validation is executed against only https://google-gruyere.appspot.com/482338906867472456097470474631954304306/.
All outbound validation requests are logged or summarized to prove they stayed under the authorized instance root.
The evidence states whether xss-extended detects each of the three expected Gruyere variants and includes structured finding output or an honest miss reason.
If a narrow runner repair is required, focused tests are added or updated and the repair remains limited to backlog-220 variant detection.

acceptance_criteria: The authorized Gruyere instance root is the only live target root used for validation.
The evidence includes official Gruyere documentation-derived contexts and real-lab results for all three backlog-220 variants.
Any miss is recorded as product truth with a bounded next action rather than hidden behind green fixture tests.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Changing the active task order silently
Testing outside the authorized instance root
DoS, code execution, path traversal, SQL injection, or account takeover
